title: Nilpotent-free spaces of 3 x 3 matrices over the field with three elements

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
Wigderson conjectured (arXiv:2609.29177, Conjecture 8) that for every finite field F and every n there is a space of n x n matrices over F of dimension n^2 - binom(n,2) whose only nilpotent element is zero. We show that every six-dimensional space of 3 x 3 matrices over F_3 contains a nonzero nilpotent matrix, so the conjecture fails for F = F_3 and n = 3; the largest possible dimension is five. The conjecture holds for n <= 2 over every finite field and for n = 3 over F_2 and F_5.

The archive contains the paper (PDF, LaTeX source with the figures as PNG, arXiv tarball), the dated priority check, a Lean 4 development with Mathlib that proves every result of the paper (the finite search is evaluated by compiled code; all other steps use only the standard axioms), and independent exhaustive checks in C, C++ and Python.
